setting.environment: ZOO: inside a zoo with animals and visitors around
setting.activity: Guiding a private VIP tour near the big cats

dialog.input_text: This tiger enclosure is magnificent. Can we get closer to the glass?
dialog.agent_text: Absolutely! If you follow me just down this ramp, we have a private viewing area reserved for your tour. The visibility is fantastic there.

dialog.input_text: Oh, look at the size of those paws. It's truly breathtaking.
Incredible. Make sure you get a photo of this for the family group chat.
I already have the camera ready. Just lean in a bit closer to the glass.
Do they always sleep this much during the day? They seem quite lazy.
dialog.agent_text: They actually are! Big cats conserve a lot of energy and usually spend a large portion of their day resting. They become much more active toward dusk.

dialog.input_text: Excuse me, we have a tight schedule. How long does the walk to the private dining pavilion take from here?
dialog.agent_text: It is a very short stroll. We can head in that direction whenever you are ready, and our culinary team will be prepared for your arrival.

dialog.input_text: Let's give it another moment. I want to see if the big one gets up.
Understood. I will message the catering staff to hold the appetizers.
Alright, I've seen enough. Lead the way to lunch, please.
dialog.agent_text: Right this way. We will pass by the botanical gardens on our route, which is lovely this time of year.
